relation: the Horner evaluation of a natural coefficient list (lowest degree first) at a natural point, with GTBase.poly_nat.horner_nat p x := mathcomp poly.horner_rec p x at the natural semiring canonical: the six Fixpoints Chromatic X3/X124, Extremal X59/X60, GTMisc X128/X139 xN_poly_eval, the foldr Minor X220 x220_poly_eval and the public foldr Chromatic.foundations.chi_bounding.horner_nat are transparent aliases of it, each related to its frozen original by an UNCONDITIONAL pointwise equality (induction or the foldr bridge; not a conversion), so every row using them is equivalent in every polarity. The empty list evaluates to 0 at every point; no guard.
summary: Batch A, family A31 (natural Horner evaluation, stage 1 of the polynomial scope; the P-list class owner is the separate stage A32), on the reviewed CANDIDATE parent A30 db16a76 (not accepted main). New GTBase.poly_nat.horner_nat p x := mathcomp poly.horner_rec p x at nat, a thin adapter in a narrow-import module (ssralg/poly Required, only ssralg canonicals imported; not re-exported by GTBase.base), with the nil/cons-complete API clients need (nil, cons, foldr shape, x = 0, monomial, trailing zero, monotonicity, domination for 1 <= t). The six Fixpoints X3/X124/X59/X60/X128/X139 xN_poly_eval, X220's foldr x220_poly_eval and the public foldr chi_bounding.horner_nat become transparent aliases. Public client base/theories/examples/poly_nat.v (coefficient order 321/123, the dom-guard counterexample).

Frozen verbatim at the parent: the eight raw evaluators, the chains x3_polynomially_chi_bounded, x66_good, x124_poly_chi_bounded, x128_expansion_bounded, x139_polynomial_expansion_class and x220_polynomial_expansion, and the twelve whole rows (X3 negated class, X65, X66, X124, X59, X98, X60, X128, X139 and X220's three).
